entry.title: Indie Web: Write more?
entry.content:
• This post was written in BLR Indie Web Club writing session.

As I've spoken on I've Consumed Enough, I accidentally discovered Bengaluru Indie Web Club on mastodon by abhinav tushar. And ever since I had a blog site, why did it not occur to me that I should have searched for some clubs like these to improve my writing, and get motivated to write more. Maybe I was too involved in May I Recommend EWM, and as you see I started Revamp the blogs from January, and till July I did not get another push…?

Nevertheless, every-time is a right time to start the work. So as of I'm writing this post, this is my first BLR Indie Web Club meetup, and this is club's 31st meetup. So here's to the great day of writers coming together, am writing this post based on the prompt of discovering a random image from WikiMedia commons and making a post about it.

And look what I found randomly… Lucky for me it was a tree (garden or park Idk).

A random image found via Wikimedia Commons. Source: WikiMedia

I dont know about the place since the page has all info in Italian language nor I'm writing about the place. Picture can definitely speak 1000 words (yes this phrase was repeated many times in today's session, so cheers to it.)

All I can see is the peaceful and lovely tree, sitting in the shadowy realms of every day life. Its always the nature that makes me a take a moment in life, sit back, relax and reflect on whats happening around me. Day by day life seems so busy that I fail to acknowledge whats even next to me, so much focused work is also harming me lol. And here's a simple park or a garden that can make me relive a lost moment and make me process my living state and always guide me to think I've Consumed Enough.

Apart from main focus on tree in the image, there are two people, a house behind, the one half of a gate and so on, I'm not giving opinion on them, those are yours to interpret (if you can!) and follow any details.. its a static image after all, I only wrote about ~160 words, you fill the rest of the 840 words please!

Another things I learned today was that August month are considered as Blaugust time and Indie web circle practice to publish one post each day, so totaling 31 posts for this month. Its easy to do micro blog, but heck I need to find topics to even try it, but I may as well give it a try so I get disciplined as well. This also stops me from updating my site eamcs theme and start writing more to utilize them feature-fully and then analyze the need and whats actually required for my site/posts.

  • The 2026 edition is happening here.

Finally, cheers to the first embark of long-overdue tasks on writing and to blog more. I tried to start in Jan, and here finally in August 2026 I'm able to get the actual start. And on good side I've been writing daily journal from past week, so that's again a good start to more writing.

Still I need to write more, but gosh Times Up! 30 mins got me only so far?

Note: 10 mins was extended, But Imma use that time to clean and fix grammar. Its also time for me to reflect what could 30mins of my brain write and converse in text.
